rationale: The extracted position sum of 544,170,799 conflicts with two independent raw-filing presentations of the March 31, 2026 debt-and-equity fair value: the schedule total is 224,956,333 and the fair-value hierarchy reports Level 3 investments of 224,956 thousand.
